system.story: Masters the big machine - often Jumped-In as the deadliest single thing on the field.

description.value:
Subclass: Vehicle - the Rigger/Pilot. Masters the big machine: the armored hauler, the assault bike, the gunship, the sub. Fewer bodies, more mass. The frontline-in-a-vehicle build.

Role Feature - One With the Machine

Your Jump-In (Ascendant) costs 1 less Uptime and grants a larger Integrity buffer; while Jumped-In you count as both pilot and gunner with an extra edge on either.

Signature Tweak

Rigged Fire from a Jumped-In vehicle can strike two targets in a line (the vehicle's heavy mount).

Bonus Skill & Contact

Piloting / vehicle-control, plus a chop-shop or transport-fixer contact.

Chrome Flavor

A high-bandwidth control rig built for deep Jump-In.
